title: Research Fellow / Creative Technologist
department: Institute of Design Innovation / Digital Health Institute
description: Research Fellow and Creative Technologist at the Digital Health Institute (DHI), scoping and executing design-led Experience Labs in Forres, under Don MacIntyre. Led pre-technology knowledge elicitation with healthcare, civic, and business participants across several co-design projects including Backpack (personal data stores for MS patients) and Digital Brokering (community actor-network mapping).
